Andhra Pradesh to develop policy and referral centers for rare diseases

The Andhra Pradesh government has announced plans to create a policy specifically for rare diseases. As part of this initiative, the state intends to establish referral centers to manage and treat these conditions. This move aims to provide better healthcare access and support for individuals affected by rare diseases within the state.
